queries.name: mixed_types_10000
queries.sql: SELECT number, toString(number) AS label, cityHash64(number) AS hash, number % 100 AS bucket FROM numbers(10000)

queries.name: result_stream_50000
queries.sql: SELECT number, toString(number) AS label, cityHash64(number) AS hash FROM numbers(50000)

queries.name: cpu_progress_aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT sum(cityHash64(number)) AS checksum, count() AS n FROM numbers(5000000)

queries.name: non_finite_float_json
queries.sql: SELECT number % (number / 2) AS value, count() AS count FROM numbers(1000000) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY isNaN(value), value

queries.name: active_query_log_example
queries.sql: SELECT event_time, query_duration_ms, read_rows, read_bytes, memory_usage, query FROM system.query_log WHERE event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND type = 'QueryFinish' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 10000
